name: code_review_live
description: code_review: run review-changes on a seeded-bug repository and on a clean refactor
default_prompt: Review two repositories with the workflow tool, one after the other. First run `sh ${GENTS_LIVE_ROOT:-.}/make_repos.sh` in bash. Then, for review_seeded_bug and then review_clean_refactor under ${GENTS_LIVE_ROOT:-.}: call workflow with argv ["run","review-changes"], agent_budget 32 and args {"repository": "<name>", "base": "HEAD~1", "head": "HEAD"}. Take the job key session_id:tool_call_id from the receipt and keep it whole. The result arrives later as a message, so end your turn instead of polling. When the job completes, call workflow with argv ["result", "<key>"], then run `sh ${GENTS_LIVE_ROOT:-.}/counts_balance.sh <label> <candidate> <confirmed> <refuted> <unverified>` with the label seeded for review_seeded_bug or clean for review_clean_refactor, and the four counts from that result. Finish with two sentences: what each review confirmed, and whether its counts balanced.
